title: Iceland's no vote does not undermine the EU's appeal
subhead: Driven in part by concerns over reopening the issue of fishing rights, the Icelandic referendum at the end of August disappointed supporters of European integration. Yet the EU continues to be seen as a stable regional center of governance that many other partners still want to draw closer to.

Why loneliness is now seen as a harmful epidemic for mental and physical health
subhead: In France, nearly one in four people reported feeling lonely in 2025. This isolation particularly affects young people and the elderly, and could be a significant source of suffering. Among the possible ways to counter it are taking part in local activities and encouraging more volunteering.

title: Unprecedented drop in French students' performance echoes worldwide decline
subhead: Reading and maths scores for 15-year-olds in France have fallen to their lowest levels since 2000, mirroring trends seen in comparable countries. Among the reasons cited to explain this global phenomenon are attitudes toward learning, the role of digital technology, the lasting effects of the Covid-19 crisis and a lack of parental involvement. In France, significant social and gender inequalities persist.
